headline: CFTC Unveils Proposed Rules for Retail Digital Asset Transactions
summary: The CFTC issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking for Regulation CTX and CAM, providing an optional federal registration pathway for retail crypto commodity exchanges.
why: The CFTC oversees US derivatives and commodity markets, and clearer regulatory guidelines shape compliance and institutional adoption in crypto.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Exchanges
impacts.why: An optional federal registration framework clarifies rules and reduces regulatory risk for digital asset trading platforms.
